d: China is expanding its footprint in the disputed South China Sea, with satellite images revealing a nearly three-kilometre runway under construction at Antelope Reef in the Paracel Islands. The reef, claimed by China, Vietnam and Taiwan, has undergone a dramatic transformation through large-scale land reclamation in just ten months. Alongside the runway, Beijing is developing harbour infrastructure that could strengthen its military and logistical capabilities in the region.
